passages.text: Note: In typifying the name, Fryxell (and in Lundellia 5: 82. 2002) incorrectly treated this as the basionym of Sida americana (L.) L. 1763. However, there are no cited elements in common, the diagnoses are far from identical and, perhaps crucially, Linnaeus recognises both L. americana and S. americana in Sp. Pl., ed. 2 (pp. 973 and 963 respectively).
[" Habitat in Jamaica. "] Sp. Pl., ed. 2, 2: 973 (1763). RCN: 5065.
Lectotype (Fryxell in Syst. Bot. Monogr. 25: 30. 1988): Browne, Herb. Linn. No. 871.7 (LINN).
